description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer based in United States. 

 As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning solutions, with a particular focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and intelligent AI-powered applications. You will take ownership of the ML development lifecycle, from initial research and experimentation to model training, fine-tuning, integration, and production deployment. Working closely with backend engineers and product teams, you will transform complex machine learning concepts into scalable, practical, and user-focused features. You will apply your understanding of machine learning and deep learning fundamentals to build efficient, reliable, and high-impact AI systems. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern LLM frameworks, emerging AI technologies, and production-grade ML infrastructure. You will join an engineering-focused environment that values technical excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation. Arabic language proficiency is essential for this position.



Accountabilities:
 

 Machine Learning Development: Design, develop, and implement machine learning solutions from initial concept and experimentation through to production deployment.

 LLM Training and Fine-Tuning: Train, fine-tune, and integrate Large Language Models, applying practical knowledge of transformer architectures and modern model adaptation techniques.

 AI Feature Development: Build and integrate intelligent, AI-powered features into real-world applications, ensuring they deliver practical value and an effective user experience.

 Production Deployment: Deploy, scale, and monitor LLM-powered functionalities in production environments, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability.

 Model Optimization: Explore opportunities to improve model performance, efficiency, and inference capabilities through appropriate optimization techniques.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers, software developers, and product teams to translate business and product requirements into effective machine learning solutions.

 Software Engineering: Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-structured Python code while following sound software engineering principles and best practices.

 Data Management: Work with machine learning datasets and data processing tools to prepare, manipulate, and manage data for model training and evaluation.

 Technical Documentation: Produce clear technical documentation covering model architectures, implementation approaches, experiments, and deployment processes.

 Research and Innovation: Stay up to date with developments in machine learning research, LLM capabilities, emerging AI frameworks, and MLOps practices, identifying opportunities to improve existing solutions.


 Requirements:


 Arabic Language: Professional Arabic language proficiency is mandatory.

 Professional Experience: At least 1 year of non-internship professional experience in machine learning engineering or a closely related field.

 Machine Learning Fundamentals: Strong theoretical understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts, including the underlying principles of algorithms, architectures, and model behavior.

 LLM Expertise: Practical experience training and fine-tuning Large Language Models, with a solid understanding of transformer architectures and their applications.

 Python Development: Strong production-level Python programming skills and experience developing reliable, scalable software solutions.

 Software Engineering Fundamentals: Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Object-Oriented Design (OOD), and Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA).

 LLM Frameworks: Familiarity with modern machine learning and LLM integration frameworks, such as Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, and LangChain.

 Data Processing: Experience working with machine learning data pipelines and data manipulation libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.

 Research and Documentation: Strong analytical and research capabilities, combined with excellent technical writing and documentation skills.

 Communication and Collaboration: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams.

 Problem-Solving: A structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting, experimentation, and developing solutions to complex technical challenges.

 Continuous Learning: Genuine interest in emerging AI technologies, machine learning research, and the ongoing evolution of LLM capabilities.


 Nice-to-Have Skills:


 Experience deploying and maintaining LLM-powered features in production environments.

 Knowledge of parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA, QLoRA, and PEFT.

 Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and vector databases such as Pinecone and Weaviate.

 Understanding of model serving and inference optimization techniques, including quantization and batching.

 Exposure to MLOps practices, including model monitoring, version control, and CI/CD pipelines for machine learning.

 Experience developing RESTful APIs and working with Docker and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Microsoft Azure.

 Interest or experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), intelligent assistants, and chatbot development.


 Benefits:


 Opportunity to work remotely in an internationally oriented environment.

 Full-time employment opportunity with exposure to modern machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies.

 Hands-on experience designing, training, and deploying advanced Large Language Models.

 Opportunity to contribute to the development of intelligent, user-facing AI applications.

 Collaboration with backend engineering and product teams on innovative technical projects.

 Exposure to modern ML frameworks, model optimization techniques, and production-grade AI systems.

 Opportunities for continuous technical learning, research, and professional development.

 Ability to contribute to the complete machine learning lifecycle, from experimentation to production deployment.
